title: Coordinated DAO Treasury Rebalancing with Risk Validation
narrative: A DAO has voted to rebalance its treasury from the current allocation (80% ETH / 20% USDC) to a new target (50% ETH / 30% USDC / 20% DAI). Three specialized agents must coordinate: (1) treasury_manager proposes the allocation plan and initiates the rebalancing, (2) risk_monitor validates the plan against risk parameters, and (3) execution_agent executes the swaps via TWAP. The collective treasury holds 5000 ETH and 2,000,000 USDC. The deadline for execution is 7 days from the governance vote (2026-05-28).

agents.mission: Propose and coordinate the rebalancing plan: receive the allocation mandate, compute the rebalancing schedule, delegate execution to the execution agent, and confirm completion within 7 days.
Validate the rebalancing plan against market risk parameters: check pool liquidity depth, estimate slippage for proposed trade sizes, verify price conditions, and approve or reject the plan.
Execute the approved rebalancing swaps using TWAP strategy with minimum slippage and track all transaction costs.

trigger_event.description: Governance proposal TRE-2026-05-B passed, mandating treasury rebalancing from 80% ETH / 20% USDC to 50% ETH / 30% USDC / 20% DAI within 7 days. Treasury: 5000 ETH ($14.1M at $2820), 2M USDC ($2M). Total: $16.1M.
trigger_event.onchain_evidence: Proposal 0xDEF... executed via DAO Governor contract at block 20540000 on 2026-05-28T10:00:00Z

expected_coordination_flow.action: Parse governance mandate: target allocation 50% ETH / 30% USDC / 20% DAI. Compute current allocation: 5000 ETH * $2820 = $14.1M (87.6%), 2M USDC = $2M (12.4%). Total = $16.1M. Target: $8.05M ETH = 2855 ETH (sell 2145 ETH), $4.83M USDC = 4.83M USDC (need +2.83M USDC), $3.22M DAI = 3.22M DAI (acquire from ETH sales).

Validate the plan against market conditions: check Uniswap V3 ETH/USDC 0.05% pool liquidity ($450M), ETH/DAI 0.05% pool liquidity ($120M), and Cow Swap volume ($340M/24h). Verify maximum trade size for <0.3% slippage: ETH/USDC ~1000 ETH per trade, ETH/DAI ~300 ETH per trade.
expected_coordination_flow.kg_update: SharedKG:RiskValidation → {plan_id: TRE-2026-05-B, max_trade_ETH_USDC: 1000, max_trade_ETH_DAI: 300, recommended_splits: 3-5 days, slippage_estimate: 0.002-0.003, status: approved}

expected_coordination_flow.action: Approve the rebalancing plan with conditions: (1) do not exceed 1000 ETH in a single DEX trade, (2) use Cow Swap for MEV protection, (3) split DAI acquisition across Uniswap V3 and Curve since ETH/DAI liquidity is thinner ($120M).

Delegate execution plan to execution_agent: sell 2145 ETH over 3 days (715 ETH/day), split each day across morning and afternoon sessions. 60% of daily sales to USDC (429 ETH/day), 40% to DAI (286 ETH/day). Use Cow Swap for batch auctions.

Execute Day 1, Session 1: sell 357.5 ETH via Cow Swap. Route 214.5 ETH → USDC, 143 ETH → DAI (splitting DAI 60/40 between Uniswap V3 and Curve via 1inch). Verify execution price within 0.3% of Chainlink oracle price.
Execute Day 1, Session 2: remaining 357.5 ETH. Confirm cumulative slippage < 0.3%. Report: Day 1 complete — 715 ETH sold, ~$2.01M received (~$1.21M USDC + ~$0.80M DAI).
expected_coordination_flow.kg_update: SharedKG:RebalanceProgress → {day: 1, ETH_sold: 715, total_ETH_remaining: 4285, USDC_acquired: 1210000, DAI_acquired: 800000, cumulative_slippage: 0.0022, status: on_track}

expected_coordination_flow.action: Execute Days 2 and 3 following the same pattern. After Day 3: total 2145 ETH sold, ~$6.05M received.
Confirm final treasury state: 2855 ETH ($8.05M), 4.83M USDC ($4.83M), 3.22M DAI ($3.22M). Total = $16.1M + any excess from favorable slippage. Report to treasury_manager.
expected_coordination_flow.kg_update: SharedKG:RebalanceComplete → {final_ETH: 2855, final_USDC: 4830000, final_DAI: 3220000, total_gas_cost_ETH: 0.45, avg_slippage: 0.0025, status: completed}

expected_coordination_flow.action: Final audit: verify final allocation matches target (50/30/20 within ±1%), check all transactions on-chain, confirm gas costs within budget. Report to governance.
expected_coordination_flow.kg_update: SharedKG:RebalanceAudit → {allocation_deviation_pct: {ETH: 0.3, USDC: 0.2, DAI: 0.5}, transactions_verified: 12, issues_found: 0, status: compliant}

coordination_efficiency.description: Total steps taken vs. expected optimal (9 steps)

consensus_latency.description: Time from treasury_manager proposing plan to risk_monitor approving with conditions

communication_overhead.description: Total messages exchanged between agents for the entire rebalance

system_resilience.description: What happens when execution_agent fails mid-way during Day 2 execution

scale.1: Rebalance stalls; governance must manually intervene
scale.3: treasury_manager detects timeout after 2h, reassigns remaining trades to backup execution agent
scale.5: Automatic failover within 15 minutes: pending trades are picked up by backup execution agent with zero state loss via shared KG
